Definition: to pitch over or reel; hence (transitively) to cast down or out
BiblicalUsage: ṭûwl is the word for to cast down, to hurl. In 1 Samuel 18:11, Saul cast the javelin, and it appears again in Job 41:9.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the spear Saul hurled and the beast Job could not tame both show me how small my strength is.
